description: This Scala source file defines the ExplainUtils object, which provides utility functions for explaining and analyzing Spark SQL query plans, including generating operator IDs, collecting operators, processing subqueries, and setting codegen IDs.

classes.name: ExplainUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing methods for explaining Spark SQL query plans, including ID generation, operator collection, subquery processing, and plan annotation.

methods.name: processPlanSkippingSubqueries
methods.description: Generates explain output for a plan, skipping subqueries, and appends verbose operator info.

methods.name: processPlan
methods.description: Generates explain output for a plan, including subqueries and optimized-out exchanges, managing operator IDs.

methods.name: generateOperatorIDs
methods.description: Assigns unique IDs to operators in a plan, traversing bottom-up, handling special cases like subqueries and reused exchanges.

methods.name: collectOperatorsWithID
methods.description: Collects operators with assigned IDs from a plan in a bottom-up traversal.

methods.name: generateWholeStageCodegenIds
methods.description: Assigns codegen stage IDs to plan nodes, skipping subqueries.

methods.name: generateFieldString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a field with its values.

methods.name: getSubqueries
methods.description: Extracts subquery plans and their hosting expressions from a plan.

methods.name: getOpId
methods.description: Retrieves the operator ID for a plan node based on its tag.
